_说明: 成本执行台允许执行的全部操作（白名单）。服务只执行这里登记的语句；参数按 params 的顺序绑定到 ?，先用 validators 校验格式。kind=query 在只读事务中执行并回滚；kind=call 是后台长操作（计算、检查、承接，只写 MTC_CA_*），同一时间只允许一个；kind=exec 是同步的小写操作（维护模拟场景，只写 MTC_CA_C_SCENARIO*），执行后提交。confirm=always / runTypeF 表示需要输入账套名确认。改动后两个服务（cost_console.ps1、dev_server.py）都会读到。

ping.sql: SELECT CURRENT_USER AS "User", CURRENT_SCHEMA AS "Schema", (SELECT DATABASE_NAME FROM SYS.M_DATABASE) AS "Db", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SYS.OBJECTS WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = CURRENT_SCHEMA AND OBJECT_NAME = 'MTC_CA_P_RUN') AS "HasNew" FROM DUMMY

codeDict.sql: SELECT 'TRANS' AS "Dict", "Code", "Name" FROM "@MTC_COST_IOTYPE" UNION ALL SELECT 'TRANS', "TrnsCode", "TrnsCodDsc" FROM "OTRC" UNION ALL SELECT 'BUSI', "Code", "Name" FROM "@U_CIOTRN" UNION ALL SELECT 'RULE', "RuleId", "Title" FROM "MTC_CA_C_RULE" UNION ALL SELECT 'CHECK', "CheckId", "Title" FROM "MTC_CA_C_CHECK" UNION ALL SELECT 'POOL', "PoolCode", "PoolName" FROM "MTC_CA_C_POOL" UNION ALL SELECT 'ACCT', "AcctCode", "AcctName" FROM "OACT" UNION ALL SELECT 'ACCT', "FormatCode", "AcctName" FROM "OACT" WHERE IFNULL("FormatCode", '') <> '' AND "FormatCode" <> "AcctCode"

periods.sql: SELECT TOP 36 "Code", "PeriodStat" FROM OFPR ORDER BY "Code" DESC

periodStatus.sql: SELECT TOP 36 "FcCode", "PeriodStat", "Status", "CostStatus", "CalcRunId", "PostRunId", "PostUser", "PostTime", "LastOkRunId" FROM "MTC_CA_V_PERIOD" ORDER BY "FcCode" DESC

jvList.title: 已生成的凭单
jvList.sql: SELECT J."JvId", J."RunId", J."TransCode", O."TrnsCodDsc" AS "TransName", J."BatchNum", J."Status", CASE WHEN J."BatchNum" IS NULL THEN '' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "OBTF" T WHERE T."BatchNum" = J."BatchNum" AND T."BtfStatus" = 'O') THEN '待过账' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "OJDT" H WHERE H."BatchNum" = J."BatchNum") THEN '已过账' ELSE '已删除' END AS "B1State", J."Debit", J."Credit", J."LineCnt", J."CreateUser", J."CreateTime", J."DelUser", J."DelTime", J."Msg" FROM "MTC_CA_JV" J LEFT JOIN "OTRC" O ON O."TrnsCode" = J."TransCode" WHERE J."FcCode" = ? ORDER BY J."JvId" DESC

jvChecks.title: 生成凭单：计算后校验阻断项与确认
jvChecks.sql: SELECT C."RunId", C."CheckId", K."Title", C."Msg", A."UserCode" AS "AckUser", A."AckTime", A."Reason" AS "AckReason" FROM "MTC_CA_R_CHECK" C LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_C_CHECK" K ON K."CheckId" = C."CheckId" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_CHECK_ACK" A ON A."RunId" = C."RunId" AND A."CheckId" = C."CheckId" WHERE C."RunId" = (SELECT MAX("RunId") FROM "MTC_CA_RUN" WHERE "FcCode" = ? AND "RunType" = 'F' AND "Scenario" = '' AND "Status" = 'OK') AND C."Stage" = 'POST' AND C."Result" = 'FAIL' ORDER BY C."CheckId"

checkAck.title: 确认计算后校验阻断项

checkUnack.title: 取消确认计算后校验阻断项

boot.sql: SELECT B."Fc" AS "BootFc", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "MTC_CA_BOOT_ITEM" WHERE "FcCode" = B."Fc") AS "Items", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "MTC_CA_BOOT_ORDER" WHERE "FcCode" = B."Fc") AS "Orders", (SELECT MAX("LoadTime") FROM "MTC_CA_BOOT_ITEM" WHERE "FcCode" = B."Fc") AS "LoadTime" FROM (SELECT "MTC_CA_F_PARAM"('BOOTSTRAP_FC', TO_NVARCHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')) AS "Fc" FROM DUMMY) B

runs.sql: SELECT TOP 100 "RunId", "FcCode", "RunType", "Scenario", "Initiator", "UserCode", "StartTime", "EndTime", "Status", "IterCount", "Converged", "Msg" FROM "MTC_CA_RUN" ORDER BY "RunId" DESC

steps.sql: SELECT "StepNo", "StepCode", "Status", "RowCnt", "Msg", "StartTime", "EndTime", SECONDS_BETWEEN("StartTime", IFNULL("EndTime", CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS "Sec" FROM "MTC_CA_RUN_STEP" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) ORDER BY "StepNo"

iters.sql: SELECT "Iter", "MaxPriceDelta", "PoolDelta", "CloseDifDelta", "UnconvItems", "EndTime" FROM "MTC_CA_RUN_ITER" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) ORDER BY "Iter"

checks.sql: SELECT R."CheckId", R."Stage", IFNULL(C."Title", '') AS "Title", R."Result", R."IssueCnt", R."IsBlock", R."Msg", IFNULL(C."Purpose", '') AS "Purpose", IFNULL(C."TroublePath", '') AS "TroublePath" FROM "MTC_CA_R_CHECK" R LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_C_CHECK" C ON C."CheckId" = R."CheckId" WHERE R."RunId" = CAST(? checkDtl.sql: SELECT "SeqNo", "KeyCode", "Info" FROM "MTC_CA_R_CHECK_DTL" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND "CheckId" = ? ORDER BY "SeqNo"

hoursNeed.sql: SELECT TOP 2001 H."ItemCode", H."ItemName", H."ItmsGrpCod", G."ItmsGrpNam", H."Pools", H."OrderCnt", H."RecvQty", H."CurHours", H."RefHours", H."RefFc", H."PoolNames", H."NeedOrders" FROM "MTC_CA_R_HOURS_NEED" H LEFT JOIN "OITB" G ON TO_NVARCHAR(G."ItmsGrpCod") = H."ItmsGrpCod" WHERE H."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND (? = '' OR H."ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%' OR H."ItmsGrpCod" = ?) ORDER BY H."ItmsGrpCod", H."ItemCode"

recon.sql: SELECT "Area", "AcctCode", "KeyCode", "BegBiz", "BegFin", "BegDiff", "CurBiz", "CurFin", "CurDiff", "BizAmt" AS "EndBiz", "EndFin", "Diff" AS "EndDiff", "OtherAmt", "Diff" + "OtherAmt" AS "EndDiffGl", CASE WHEN ABS("Diff" - "BegDiff") <= 0.01 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS "EndEqBeg", "DraftAmt" - "DupAmt" AS "PendAmt", "PendCodes", "DupAmt", "DupCodes", "GlAmt", "VchAmt", "Diff1", "Diff2" FROM "MTC_CA_F_RECON"(CAST(? AS BIGINT)) ORDER BY CASE "Area" WHEN 'STOCK' THEN 1 WHEN 'WIP_PROD' THEN 2 WHEN 'WW_MAT' THEN 3 WHEN 'WW_FEE' THEN 4 WHEN 'GOODS' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, "AcctCode", ABS("CurDiff") DESC, ABS("Diff") DESC, "KeyCode"

reconSrc.sql: SELECT CASE R."Phase" WHEN 'BEG' THEN '期初' ELSE '本期' END AS "Phase", R."Src", R."TransCode", C."TrnsCodDsc" AS "TransName", R."InRecon", R."Dup", R."Part", R."Amt" FROM "MTC_CA_F_RECON_LEDGER"(CAST(? AS BIGINT)) R LEFT JOIN "OTRC" C ON C."TrnsCode" = R."TransCode" WHERE R."AcctCode" = ? AND R."KeyCode" = ? ORDER BY R."Phase", CASE R."Part" WHEN 'REV' THEN 1 WHEN 'DN01' THEN 2 WHEN 'SAMPLE' THEN 3 WHEN 'DN03' THEN 4 WHEN 'ACCR' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, CASE R."Src" WHEN 'GL' THEN 1 WHEN 'VCH' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, R."TransCode"

checkSql.sql: SELECT 'P' AS "Kind", PROCEDURE_NAME AS "ProcName", DEFINITION AS "Def" FROM SYS.PROCEDURES WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = CURRENT_SCHEMA AND PROCEDURE_NAME LIKE 'MTC_CA_%' UNION ALL SELECT 'V', VIEW_NAME, DEFINITION FROM SYS.VIEWS WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = CURRENT_SCHEMA AND VIEW_NAME LIKE 'MTC_CA_%'

AS BIGINT) AND C."Kind" = ? AND (? = '' OR C."KeyCode" LIKE ? || '%' OR S."OrderNum" = ?) ORDER BY ABS(C."Diff") DESC

AS BIGINT) AND (? = '' OR "ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%') ORDER BY "iLevel", "ItemCode"

"RtOutLab", "RtOutMfg", "RtOutSub", "RtEndMat", "RtEndLab", "RtEndMfg", "RtEndSub" FROM (SELECT IFNULL(S."ItmsGrpCod", '') AS "ItmsGrpCod", G."ItmsGrpNam" AS "GrpName", R."ItemCode", S."ItemName", R."OpenQty" AS "BegQty", R."OpenMat" + R."OpenMfg" + R."OpenLab" + R."OpenSub" AS "BegAmt", R."InQty", R."InMat" + R."InMfg" + R."InLab" + R."InSub" AS "InAmt", -R."OutQty" AS "OutQty", -(R."OutMat" + R."OutMfg" + R."OutLab" + R."OutSub") AS "OutAmt", R."EndQty", R."EndAmount" AS "EndAmt", R."OpenMat" AS "BegMat", R."OpenMfg" AS "BegMfg", R."OpenLab" AS "BegLab", R."OpenSub" AS "BegSub", R."InMat" AS "InMat", R."InMfg" AS "InMfg", R."InLab" AS "InLab", R."InSub" AS "InSub", -R."OutMat" AS "OutMat", -R."OutMfg" AS "OutMfg", -R."OutLab" AS "OutLab", -R."OutSub" AS "OutSub", R."EndMat" AS "EndMat", R."EndMfg" AS "EndMfg", R."EndLab" AS "EndLab", R."EndSub" AS "EndSub", R."RtOpenMat" AS "RtBegMat", R."RtOpenLab" AS "RtBegLab", R."RtOpenMfg" AS "RtBegMfg", R."RtOpenSub" AS "RtBegSub", R."RtInMat" AS "RtInMat", R."RtInLab" AS "RtInLab", R."RtInMfg" AS "RtInMfg", R."RtInSub" AS "RtInSub", R."RtOutMat" AS "RtOutMat", R."RtOutLab" AS "RtOutLab", R."RtOutMfg" AS "RtOutMfg", R."RtOutSub" AS "RtOutSub", R."RtEndMat" AS "RtEndMat", R."RtEndLab" AS "RtEndLab", R."RtEndMfg" AS "RtEndMfg", R."RtEndSub" AS "RtEndSub" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" R LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ITEM" S ON S."RunId" = R."RunId" AND S."ItemCode" = R."ItemCode" LEFT JOIN "OITB" G ON TO_NVARCHAR(G."ItmsGrpCod") = S."ItmsGrpCod" WHERE R."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND (? = '' OR R."ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%' OR S."ItmsGrpCod" = ?) AND (R."OpenQty" <> 0 OR R."InQty" <> 0 OR R."OutQty" <> 0 OR R."EndQty" <> 0 OR R."OpenMat" + R."OpenMfg" + R."OpenLab" + R."OpenSub" <> 0 OR R."InMat" + R."InMfg" + R."InLab" + R."InSub" <> 0 OR R."OutMat" + R."OutMfg" + R."OutLab" + R."OutSub" <> 0 OR R."EndAmount" <> 0)) X ORDER BY LPAD("ItmsGrpCod", 10, '0'), "ItemCode"

invGrp.sql: SELECT "ItmsGrpCod", MAX("GrpName") AS "GrpName", COUNT(*) AS "ItemCnt", SUM("BegQty") AS "BegQty", SUM("BegAmt") AS "BegAmt", SUM("BegMat") AS "BegMat", SUM("BegMfg") AS "BegMfg", SUM("BegLab") AS "BegLab", SUM("BegSub") AS "BegSub", SUM("InQty") AS "InQty", SUM("InAmt") AS "InAmt", SUM("InMat") AS "InMat", SUM("InMfg") AS "InMfg", SUM("InLab") AS "InLab", SUM("InSub") AS "InSub", SUM("OutQty") AS "OutQty", SUM("OutAmt") AS "OutAmt", SUM("OutMat") AS "OutMat", SUM("OutMfg") AS "OutMfg", SUM("OutLab") AS "OutLab", SUM("OutSub") AS "OutSub", SUM("EndQty") AS "EndQty", SUM("EndAmt") AS "EndAmt", SUM("EndMat") AS "EndMat", SUM("EndMfg") AS "EndMfg", SUM("EndLab") AS "EndLab", SUM("EndSub") AS "EndSub" FROM (SELECT IFNULL(S."ItmsGrpCod", '') AS "ItmsGrpCod", G."ItmsGrpNam" AS "GrpName", R."ItemCode", S."ItemName", R."OpenQty" AS "BegQty", R."OpenMat" + R."OpenMfg" + R."OpenLab" + R."OpenSub" AS "BegAmt", R."InQty", R."InMat" + R."InMfg" + R."InLab" + R."InSub" AS "InAmt", -R."OutQty" AS "OutQty", -(R."OutMat" + R."OutMfg" + R."OutLab" + R."OutSub") AS "OutAmt", R."EndQty", R."EndAmount" AS "EndAmt", R."OpenMat" AS "BegMat", R."OpenMfg" AS "BegMfg", R."OpenLab" AS "BegLab", R."OpenSub" AS "BegSub", R."InMat" AS "InMat", R."InMfg" AS "InMfg", R."InLab" AS "InLab", R."InSub" AS "InSub", -R."OutMat" AS "OutMat", -R."OutMfg" AS "OutMfg", -R."OutLab" AS "OutLab", -R."OutSub" AS "OutSub", R."EndMat" AS "EndMat", R."EndMfg" AS "EndMfg", R."EndLab" AS "EndLab", R."EndSub" AS "EndSub" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" R LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ITEM" S ON S."RunId" = R."RunId" AND S."ItemCode" = R."ItemCode" LEFT JOIN "OITB" G ON TO_NVARCHAR(G."ItmsGrpCod") = S."ItmsGrpCod" WHERE R."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND (? = '' OR R."ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%' OR S."ItmsGrpCod" = ?) AND (R."OpenQty" <> 0 OR R."InQty" <> 0 OR R."OutQty" <> 0 OR R."EndQty" <> 0 OR R."OpenMat" + R."OpenMfg" + R."OpenLab" + R."OpenSub" <> 0 OR R."InMat" + R."InMfg" + R."InLab" + R."InSub" <> 0 OR R."OutMat" + R."OutMfg" + R."OutLab" + R."OutSub" <> 0 OR R."EndAmount" <> 0)) X GROUP BY "ItmsGrpCod" ORDER BY LPAD("ItmsGrpCod", 10, '0')

invLedger.sql: SELECT TOP 2001 "ItemCode", "ItemName", "Seq", "DocDate", "ObjType", "DocNum", "LineNum", "TransCode", "TransName", "BusiType", "WhsCode", "OrderType", "OrderEntry", "OrderNum", "InQty", "InAmt" / NULLIF("InQty", 0) AS "InPrice", "InAmt", "OutQty", "OutAmt" / NULLIF("OutQty", 0) AS "OutPrice", "OutAmt", "BalQty", "BalAmt" / NULLIF("BalQty", 0) AS "BalPrice", "BalAmt", "PriceSrc" FROM (SELECT R."ItemCode", S."ItemName", 0 AS "Seq", CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "LineId", CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS "DocDate", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "ObjType", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS "DocNum", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "LineNum", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "TransCode", '期初结存' AS "TransName", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "BusiType", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(8)) AS "WhsCode", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "OrderType", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "OrderEntry", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "OrderNum", CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS "InQty", CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS "InAmt", CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS "OutQty", CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)) AS "OutAmt", R."OpenQty" AS "BalQty", R."OpenMat" + R."OpenMfg" + R."OpenLab" + R."OpenSub" AS "BalAmt", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS "PriceSrc" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" R LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ITEM" S ON S."RunId" = R."RunId" AND S."ItemCode" = R."ItemCode" WHERE R."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND (? <> '' AND (R."ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%' OR S."ItmsGrpCod" = ?)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "MTC_CA_R_LINE" L WHERE L."RunId" = R."RunId" AND L."ItemCode" = R."ItemCode") UNION ALL SELECT L."ItemCode", S."ItemName", 1, L."LineId", D."DocDate", D."ObjType", D."DocNum", D."LineNum", L."TransCode", T."Name", D."BusiType", D."WhsCode", L."OrderType", L."OrderEntry", SO."OrderNum", CASE WHEN (L."Qty" > 0 OR (L."Qty" = 0 AND NOT (LEFT(IFNULL(L."TransCode", 'I'), 1) = 'O' AND L."TransCode" <> 'O06'))) THEN L."Qty" END, CASE WHEN (L."Qty" > 0 OR (L."Qty" = 0 AND NOT (LEFT(IFNULL(L."TransCode", 'I'), 1) = 'O' AND L."TransCode" <> 'O06'))) THEN L."Amount" END, CASE WHEN NOT (L."Qty" > 0 OR (L."Qty" = 0 AND NOT (LEFT(IFNULL(L."TransCode", 'I'), 1) = 'O' AND L."TransCode" <> 'O06'))) THEN -L."Qty" END, CASE WHEN NOT (L."Qty" > 0 OR (L."Qty" = 0 AND NOT (LEFT(IFNULL(L."TransCode", 'I'), 1) = 'O' AND L."TransCode" <> 'O06'))) THEN -L."Amount" END, R."OpenQty" + SUM(L."Qty") OVER (PARTITION BY L."ItemCode" ORDER BY D."DocDate", L."LineId" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), R."OpenMat" + R."OpenMfg" + R."OpenLab" + R."OpenSub" + SUM(L."Amount") OVER (PARTITION BY L."ItemCode" ORDER BY D."DocDate", L."LineId" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), L."PriceSrc" FROM "MTC_CA_R_LINE" L JOIN "MTC_CA_S_LINE" D ON D."RunId" = L."RunId" AND D."LineId" = L."LineId" JOIN "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" R ON R."RunId" = L."RunId" AND R."ItemCode" = L."ItemCode" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ITEM" S ON S."RunId" = L."RunId" AND S."ItemCode" = L."ItemCode" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ORDER" SO ON SO."RunId" = L."RunId" AND SO."OrderType" = L."OrderType" AND SO."OrderEntry" = L."OrderEntry" LEFT JOIN "@MTC_COST_IOTYPE" T ON T."Code" = L."TransCode" WHERE L."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND (? <> '' AND (L."ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%' OR S."ItmsGrpCod" = ?)) AND NOT (D."ObjType" IN ('13', '14') AND L."Qty" = 0 AND L."Amount" = 0) UNION ALL SELECT R."ItemCode", S."ItemName", 2 AS "Seq", CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "LineId", CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS "DocDate", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "ObjType", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS "DocNum", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "LineNum", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "TransCode", '零库存尾差结转（JZ04，TAIL-01）' AS "TransName", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "BusiType", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(8)) AS "WhsCode", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "OrderType", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "OrderEntry", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "OrderNum", CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)), CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(19,6)), 0, -R."TailAmt", R."EndQty", R."EndAmount", CAST('期末数量 0，尾差在 ±TAIL_MAX 以内，结转到 TAIL_ADJ 科目' AS NVARCHAR(200)) FROM "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" R LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ITEM" S ON S."RunId" = R."RunId" AND S."ItemCode" = R."ItemCode" WHERE R."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND (? <> '' AND (R."ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%' OR S."ItmsGrpCod" = ?)) AND R."TailAmt" <> 0 UNION ALL SELECT R."ItemCode", S."ItemName", 3 AS "Seq", CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "LineId", CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS "DocDate", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "ObjType", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS "DocNum", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "LineNum", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "TransCode", '本期合计' AS "TransName", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "BusiType", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(8)) AS "WhsCode", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "OrderType", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "OrderEntry", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "OrderNum", R."InQty", R."InMat" + R."InMfg" + R."InLab" + R."InSub", -R."OutQty", -(R."OutMat" + R."OutMfg" + R."OutLab" + R."OutSub"), R."EndQty", R."EndAmount", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200)) FROM "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" R LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ITEM" S ON S."RunId" = R."RunId" AND S."ItemCode" = R."ItemCode" WHERE R."RunId" = CAST(? traceItemSrc.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST('OPEN' AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "Kind", CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "Cat", CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "TransCode", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(20)) AS "OrderType", CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS "OrderEntry", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS "OrderNum", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "WorType", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(50)) AS "SrcItem", CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(200)) AS "SrcItemName", CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS "Lines", "OpenQty" AS "Qty", "OpenMat" AS "MatAmt", "OpenMfg" AS "MfgAmt", "OpenLab" AS "LabAmt", "OpenSub" AS "SubAmt" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND "ItemCode" = ? AND ("OpenQty" <> 0 OR "OpenMat" <> 0 OR "OpenMfg" <> 0 OR "OpenLab" <> 0 OR "OpenSub" <> 0) UNION ALL SELECT X."Kind", X."Cat", X."TransCode", X."OT", X."OE", MAX(O."OrderNum"), MAX(O."WorType"), X."SrcItem", MAX(SI."ItemName"), COUNT(*), SUM(X."Qty"), SUM(X."MatAmt"), SUM(X."MfgAmt"), SUM(X."LabAmt"), SUM(X."SubAmt") FROM (SELECT L."RunId", CAST(CASE WHEN L."Cat" = 'RCPT' AND L."OrderEntry" IS NOT NULL THEN 'ORDER' WHEN B."ItemCode" IS NOT NULL THEN 'TRF' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS NVARCHAR(10)) AS "Kind", L."Cat", IFNULL(L."TransCode", '') AS "TransCode", CASE WHEN L."Cat" = 'RCPT' THEN L."OrderType" END AS "OT", CASE WHEN L."Cat" = 'RCPT' THEN L."OrderEntry" END AS "OE", B."ItemCode" AS "SrcItem", L."Qty", L."MatAmt", L."MfgAmt", L."LabAmt", L."SubAmt" FROM "MTC_CA_R_LINE" L LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_R_PAIR" P ON P."RunId" = L."RunId" AND P."LineId" = L."LineId" AND P."PairType" = 'TRF' LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_R_LINE" B ON B."RunId" = P."RunId" AND B."LineId" = P."SrcLineId" WHERE L."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND L."ItemCode" = ? AND L."InVal" = 'Y') X LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ORDER" O ON O."RunId" = X."RunId" AND O."OrderType" = X."OT" AND O."OrderEntry" = X."OE" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ITEM" SI ON SI."RunId" = X."RunId" AND SI."ItemCode" = X."SrcItem" GROUP BY X."RunId", X."Kind", X."Cat", X."TransCode", X."OT", X."OE", X."SrcItem") T ORDER BY CASE "Kind" WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 WHEN 'ORDER' THEN 1 WHEN 'TRF' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, ABS("MatAmt" + "MfgAmt" + "LabAmt" + "SubAmt") DESC, "Cat", "TransCode"

AS BIGINT) AND M."OrderType" = ? AND M."OrderEntry" = CAST(? AS INTEGER) AND (M."CarMat" <> 0 OR M."CarMfg" <> 0 OR M."CarLab" <> 0 OR M."CarSub" <> 0) ORDER BY ABS(M."CarMat" + M."CarMfg" + M."CarLab" + M."CarSub") DESC, M."ItemCode"

traceAlloc.sql: SELECT A."PoolCode", MAX(C."PoolName") AS "PoolName", MAX(A."Hours") AS "Hours", MAX(A."RecvQty") AS "RecvQty", MAX(A."Weight") AS "Weight", SUM(CASE WHEN A."Elem" = 'MFG' THEN A."Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "MfgAmt", SUM(CASE WHEN A."Elem" = 'LAB' THEN A."Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "LabAmt", MAX(A."Ratio") AS "Ratio", MAX(T."TotW") AS "PoolWeight", MAX(T."Cnt") AS "PoolOrders", MAX(T."Mfg") AS "PoolMfg", MAX(T."Lab") AS "PoolLab" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ALLOC" A LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_C_POOL" C ON C."PoolCode" = A."PoolCode" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "PoolCode", MAX("W") AS "TotW", MAX("N") AS "Cnt", SUM(CASE WHEN "Elem" = 'MFG' THEN "Amt" ELSE 0 END) AS "Mfg", SUM(CASE WHEN "Elem" = 'LAB' THEN "Amt" ELSE 0 END) AS "Lab" FROM (SELECT "PoolCode", "Elem", SUM("Weight") AS "W", COUNT(*) AS "N", SUM("Amount") AS "Amt" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ALLOC" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) GROUP BY "PoolCode", "Elem") GROUP BY "PoolCode") T ON T."PoolCode" = A."PoolCode" WHERE A."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND A."OrderType" = ? AND A."OrderEntry" = CAST(? AS INTEGER) GROUP BY A."PoolCode" ORDER BY A."PoolCode"

hoursByItem.sql: WITH ORD AS (SELECT "ItemCode", "OrderType", "OrderEntry", "WorType", "RecvQty" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ORDER" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND "RecvQty" <> 0), A AS (SELECT "OrderType", "OrderEntry", "PoolCode", MAX("Hours") AS "H", MAX("Weight") AS "W", MAX("Ratio") AS "R", SUM(CASE WHEN "Elem" = 'MFG' THEN "Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "Mfg", SUM(CASE WHEN "Elem" = 'LAB' THEN "Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "Lab" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ALLOC" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) GROUP BY "OrderType", "OrderEntry", "PoolCode"), PT AS (SELECT "PoolCode", MAX("W") AS "TotW" FROM (SELECT "PoolCode", "Elem", SUM("Weight") AS "W" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ALLOC" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) GROUP BY "PoolCode", "Elem") X GROUP BY "PoolCode"), H AS (SELECT "ItemCode", "Hours" FROM "MTC_CA_S_HOURS" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT)), D AS (SELECT ORD."ItemCode", ORD."RecvQty", A."PoolCode", A."W", A."Mfg", A."Lab", IFNULL(A."H", H."Hours") AS "UH", CASE WHEN A."PoolCode" IS NOT NULL THEN '已分摊' WHEN ORD."RecvQty" < 0 THEN '本期净入库为负，不分摊' WHEN ORD."WorType" = '50' THEN '委外工单，不分摊' WHEN H."ItemCode" IS NULL THEN '没有单位工时' WHEN H."Hours" = 0 THEN '单位工时为 0' ELSE '未分摊：不在费用池范围或池内没有金额' END AS "AllocState" FROM ORD LEFT JOIN A ON A."OrderType" = ORD."OrderType" AND A."OrderEntry" = ORD."OrderEntry" LEFT JOIN H ON H."ItemCode" = ORD."ItemCode") SELECT D."ItemCode", MAX(S."ItemName") AS "ItemName", MAX(RI."iLevel") AS "iLevel", D."AllocState", D."PoolCode", MAX(C."PoolName") AS "PoolName", MAX(D."UH") AS "UnitHours", COUNT(*) AS "OrderCnt", SUM(D."RecvQty") AS "RecvQty", SUM(D."W") AS "TotHours", SUM(D."W") / NULLIF(MAX(PT."TotW"), 0) * 100 AS "PoolPct", SUM(D."Mfg") AS "AllocMfg", SUM(D."Lab") AS "AllocLab", SUM(D."Mfg") + SUM(D."Lab") AS "AllocAmt", SUM(D."Mfg") / NULLIF(SUM(D."RecvQty"), 0) AS "MfgPerUnit", SUM(D."Lab") / NULLIF(SUM(D."RecvQty"), 0) AS "LabPerUnit", (SUM(D."Mfg") + SUM(D."Lab")) / NULLIF(SUM(D."W"), 0) AS "HourRate" FROM D LEFT JOIN PT ON PT."PoolCode" = D."PoolCode" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_C_POOL" C ON C."PoolCode" = D."PoolCode" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ITEM" S ON S."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND S."ItemCode" = D."ItemCode" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" RI ON RI."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND RI."ItemCode" = D."ItemCode" GROUP BY D."ItemCode", D."AllocState", D."PoolCode" ORDER BY CASE WHEN D."PoolCode" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, D."ItemCode", D."PoolCode"

hoursItemOrders.sql: SELECT ORD."OrderType", ORD."OrderEntry", S."OrderNum", ORD."WorType", ORD."ItemCode", CASE WHEN A."PoolCode" IS NOT NULL THEN '已分摊' WHEN ORD."RecvQty" < 0 THEN '本期净入库为负，不分摊' WHEN ORD."WorType" = '50' THEN '委外工单，不分摊' WHEN H."ItemCode" IS NULL THEN '没有单位工时' WHEN H."Hours" = 0 THEN '单位工时为 0' ELSE '未分摊：不在费用池范围或池内没有金额' END AS "AllocState", A."PoolCode", C."PoolName", IFNULL(A."H", H."Hours") AS "UnitHours", ORD."RecvQty", A."W" AS "TotHours", A."R" * 100 AS "PoolPct", A."Mfg" AS "AllocMfg", A."Lab" AS "AllocLab", IFNULL(A."Mfg", 0) + IFNULL(A."Lab", 0) AS "AllocAmt", ORD."CostAmt", ORD."UnitCost" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ORDER" ORD LEFT JOIN (SELECT "OrderType", "OrderEntry", "PoolCode", MAX("Hours") AS "H", MAX("Weight") AS "W", MAX("Ratio") AS "R", SUM(CASE WHEN "Elem" = 'MFG' THEN "Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "Mfg", SUM(CASE WHEN "Elem" = 'LAB' THEN "Amount" ELSE 0 END) AS "Lab" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ALLOC" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) GROUP BY "OrderType", "OrderEntry", "PoolCode") A ON A."OrderType" = ORD."OrderType" AND A."OrderEntry" = ORD."OrderEntry" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_ORDER" S ON S."RunId" = ORD."RunId" AND S."OrderType" = ORD."OrderType" AND S."OrderEntry" = ORD."OrderEntry" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_S_HOURS" H ON H."RunId" = ORD."RunId" AND H."ItemCode" = ORD."ItemCode" LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_C_POOL" C ON C."PoolCode" = A."PoolCode" WHERE ORD."RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND ORD."ItemCode" = ? AND ORD."RecvQty" <> 0 ORDER BY A."W" DESC, ORD."OrderType", ORD."OrderEntry"

AS BIGINT) AND "OrderType" = ? AND "OrderEntry" = CAST(? AS INTEGER) UNION ALL SELECT 2, '本期领料', SUM("IssMat"), SUM("IssMfg"), SUM("IssLab"), SUM("IssSub"), SUM("IssMat" + "IssMfg" + "IssLab" + "IssSub") FROM "MTC_CA_R_ORDER_MAT" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND "OrderType" = ? AND "OrderEntry" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND "OrderType" = ? AND "OrderEntry" = CAST(? AS INTEGER) UNION ALL SELECT 5, '分摊的制造费用、人工（单位工时 × 本期入库数）', 0, "AllocMfg", "AllocLab", 0, "AllocMfg" + "AllocLab" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ORDER" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND "OrderType" = ? AND "OrderEntry" = CAST(? AS INTEGER) UNION ALL SELECT 6, '本期完工成本 = 结转 + 分摊', "CostMat", "CostMfg", "CostLab", "CostSub", "CostAmt" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ORDER" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? flowAmts.sql: SELECT I."ItemCnt", I."OpenAmt", I."InAmt", I."OutAmt", I."EndAmt", I."BalDiff", O."OrderCnt", O."AllocAmt", O."CostAmt", O."CostSub", O."WipAmt", O."CloseDifAmt", L."PoolAmt", L."PoolCloseDif" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "ItemCnt", IFNULL(SUM("OpenMat" + "OpenMfg" + "OpenLab" + "OpenSub"), 0) AS "OpenAmt", IFNULL(SUM("InMat" + "InMfg" + "InLab" + "InSub"), 0) AS "InAmt", -IFNULL(SUM("OutMat" + "OutMfg" + "OutLab" + "OutSub"), 0) AS "OutAmt", IFNULL(SUM("EndAmount"), 0) AS "EndAmt", IFNULL(SUM("OpenMat" + "OpenMfg" + "OpenLab" + "OpenSub" + "InMat" + "InMfg" + "InLab" + "InSub" + "OutMat" + "OutMfg" + "OutLab" + "OutSub" - "EndAmount"), 0) AS "BalDiff" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ITEM" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT)) I, (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "OrderCnt", IFNULL(SUM("AllocMfg" + "AllocLab"), 0) AS "AllocAmt", IFNULL(SUM("CostAmt"), 0) AS "CostAmt", IFNULL(SUM("CostSub"), 0) AS "CostSub", IFNULL(SUM("WipAmt"), 0) AS "WipAmt", IFNULL(SUM("CloseDifAmt"), 0) AS "CloseDifAmt" FROM "MTC_CA_R_ORDER" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT)) L

kpiTotals.sql: SELECT "KpiType", "Value" FROM "MTC_CA_RUN_KPI" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT) AND "KeyCode" = '' ORDER BY "KpiType"

kpiCmpSummary.sql: SELECT "KpiType", COUNT(*) AS "Cnt", SUM(CASE WHEN ABS("Diff") > 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "DiffCnt", SUM(ABS("Diff")) AS "AbsDiff" FROM (SELECT IFNULL(A."KpiType", B."KpiType") AS "KpiType", IFNULL(A."KeyCode", B."KeyCode") AS "KeyCode", B."Value" AS "ValB", A."Value" AS "ValA", IFNULL(A."Value", 0) - IFNULL(B."Value", 0) AS "Diff" FROM (SELECT * FROM "MTC_CA_RUN_KPI" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT)) A FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM "MTC_CA_RUN_KPI" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT)) B ON B."KpiType" = A."KpiType" AND B."KeyCode" = A."KeyCode") GROUP BY "KpiType" ORDER BY "KpiType"

kpiCmpList.sql: SELECT TOP 2001 K."KeyCode", COALESCE(TO_NVARCHAR(W."DocNum"), TO_NVARCHAR(M."DocNum")) AS "OrderNum", K."ValB", K."ValA", K."Diff" FROM (SELECT IFNULL(A."KpiType", B."KpiType") AS "KpiType", IFNULL(A."KeyCode", B."KeyCode") AS "KeyCode", B."Value" AS "ValB", A."Value" AS "ValA", IFNULL(A."Value", 0) - IFNULL(B."Value", 0) AS "Diff" FROM (SELECT * FROM "MTC_CA_RUN_KPI" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT)) A FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM "MTC_CA_RUN_KPI" WHERE "RunId" = CAST(? AS BIGINT)) B ON B."KpiType" = A."KpiType" AND B."KeyCode" = A."KeyCode") K LEFT JOIN "OWOR" W ON W."DocEntry" = CASE WHEN K."KpiType" LIKE 'ORDER%' AND K."KeyCode" LIKE_REGEXPR '^202-[0-9]+$' THEN TO_INTEGER(SUBSTR_AFTER(K."KeyCode", '-')) END LEFT JOIN "@MTC_OWOR" M ON M."DocEntry" = CASE WHEN K."KpiType" LIKE 'ORDER%' AND K."KeyCode" LIKE_REGEXPR '^MTC_OWOR-[0-9]+$' THEN TO_INTEGER(SUBSTR_AFTER(K."KeyCode", '-')) END WHERE K."KpiType" = ? AND ABS(K."Diff") > 0.005 AND (? = '' OR K."KeyCode" LIKE ? || '%') ORDER BY ABS(K."Diff") DESC

metaTables.sql: SELECT "TableName", "Layer", "Descr", "Source" FROM "MTC_CA_M_TABLE" WHERE "InDb" = 'Y' AND (? = '' OR UPPER("TableName") LIKE '%' || UPPER(?) || '%' OR "Descr" LIKE '%' || ? || '%' OR "Source" LIKE '%' || ? || '%' OR "TableName" IN (SELECT "TableName" FROM "MTC_CA_M_COLUMN" WHERE "Descr" LIKE '%' || ? || '%')) ORDER BY CASE "Layer" WHEN 'RUN' THEN 1 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'M' THEN 3 WHEN 'S' THEN 4 WHEN 'R' THEN 5 WHEN 'B1' THEN 7 ELSE 6 END, "TableName"

metaColumns.sql: SELECT "ColumnName", "DataType", "Descr" FROM "MTC_CA_M_COLUMN" WHERE "TableName" = ? AND "InDb" = 'Y' ORDER BY "Position"

metaPools.sql: SELECT '池' AS "Kind", "PoolCode", "PoolName" AS "Key", "IsDefault" AS "Val", "Descr" FROM "MTC_CA_C_POOL" UNION ALL SELECT '来源', "PoolCode", "OcrCode", "FromFc" || '~' || "ToFc", "Descr" FROM "MTC_CA_C_POOL_SRC" UNION ALL SELECT '范围', "PoolCode", "MatchBy" || ':' || "ItmsGrpCod", "WorTypes", "Descr" FROM "MTC_CA_C_POOL_TGT" ORDER BY 2, 1, 3

b1Pool.sql: SELECT TRIM(P."Code") AS "PoolCode", P."Name" AS "PoolName", IFNULL(P."U_IsDefault", 'N') AS "IsDefault", IFNULL(P."U_IsCloseDif", 'N') AS "IsCloseDif", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "@MTC_CA_POOL1" X WHERE X."Code" = P."Code" AND IFNULL(TRIM(X."U_OcrCode"), '') <> '') AS "SrcCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "@MTC_CA_POOL2" X WHERE X."Code" = P."Code" AND IFNULL(TRIM(X."U_MatchVal"), '') <> '') AS "TgtCnt", P."U_Descr" AS "Descr" FROM "@MTC_CA_POOL" P ORDER BY 1

b1PoolSrc.sql: SELECT TRIM(X."Code") AS "PoolCode", X."LineId" AS "LineNo", X."U_OcrCode" AS "OcrCode", CASE WHEN O."PrcCode" IS NOT NULL THEN O."PrcName" WHEN K."Cnt" IS NOT NULL THEN '成本计入类型（U_CalType）：' || TO_NVARCHAR(K."Cnt") || ' 个成本中心' ELSE '（OPRC 中没有这个成本中心或成本计入类型）' END AS "OcrName", X."U_FromFc" AS "FromFc", X."U_ToFc" AS "ToFc", X."U_Descr" AS "Descr" FROM "@MTC_CA_POOL1" X LEFT JOIN "OPRC" O ON O."PrcCode" = TRIM(X."U_OcrCode") LEFT JOIN (SELECT TRIM("U_CalType") AS "CalType", COUNT(*) AS "Cnt" FROM "OPRC" WHERE IFNULL(TRIM("U_CalType"), '') <> '' GROUP BY TRIM("U_CalType")) K ON K."CalType" = TRIM(X."U_OcrCode") ORDER BY 1, 2

b1PoolTgt.sql: SELECT TRIM(X."Code") AS "PoolCode", X."LineId" AS "LineNo", UPPER(IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(X."U_MatchBy"), ''), 'GRPTYPE')) AS "MatchBy", X."U_MatchVal" AS "MatchVal", CASE WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(X."U_MatchBy"), ''), 'GRPTYPE')) = 'GRP' THEN IFNULL(B."ItmsGrpNam", '（没有这个物料组）') ELSE IFNULL(TO_NVARCHAR(G."Cnt") || ' 个物料组', '（没有物料组的车间类别是它）') END AS "MatchName", IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(X."U_WorTypes"), ''), '10,20,30,40') AS "WorTypes", X."U_FromFc" AS "FromFc", X."U_ToFc" AS "ToFc", X."U_Descr" AS "Descr" FROM "@MTC_CA_POOL2" X LEFT JOIN "OITB" B ON TO_NVARCHAR(B."ItmsGrpCod") = TRIM(X."U_MatchVal") LEFT JOIN (SELECT TRIM("U_ItemGrpType") AS "GrpType", COUNT(*) AS "Cnt" FROM "OITB" WHERE IFNULL(TRIM("U_ItemGrpType"), '') <> '' GROUP BY TRIM("U_ItemGrpType")) G ON G."GrpType" = TRIM(X."U_MatchVal") ORDER BY 1, 2

ocrPool.sql: SELECT O."PrcCode" AS "OcrCode", O."PrcName" AS "OcrName", O."DimCode", IFNULL(TRIM(O."U_CalType"), '') AS "CalType", O."Active", IFNULL(S."PoolCode", D."PoolCode") AS "PoolCode", C."PoolName", CASE WHEN S."PoolCode" IS NOT NULL AND S."Descr" LIKE 'OPRC.U\_CalType=%' ESCAPE '\' THEN '按成本计入类型' WHEN S."PoolCode" IS NOT NULL THEN '单独配置' WHEN IFNULL(TRIM(O."U_CalType"), '') <> '' THEN '默认池（成本计入类型 ' || TRIM(O."U_CalType") || ' 没有配置）' ELSE '默认池' END AS "Basis" FROM "OPRC" O LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_C_POOL_SRC" S ON S."OcrCode" = O."PrcCode" AND ? BETWEEN S."FromFc" AND S."ToFc" CROSS JOIN (SELECT MAX("PoolCode") AS "PoolCode" FROM "MTC_CA_C_POOL" WHERE "IsDefault" = 'Y') D LEFT JOIN "MTC_CA_C_POOL" C ON C."PoolCode" = IFNULL(S."PoolCode", D."PoolCode") ORDER BY 6, O."DimCode", 1

b1ExpSet.sql: SELECT TRIM(E."Code") AS "ParamCode", E."Name" AS "Descr", E1."U_FromFc" AS "FromFc", E1."U_ToFc" AS "ToFc", E1."U_Value" AS "Value", CASE WHEN E1."Code" IS NULL THEN '' WHEN ? BETWEEN IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(E1."U_FromFc"), ''), '0000-00') AND IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM(E1."U_ToFc"), ''), '9999-99') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "InFc" FROM "@MTC_CA_EXPSET" E LEFT JOIN "@MTC_CA_EXPSET1" E1 ON E1."Code" = E."Code" ORDER BY 1, 3

b1Param.sql: SELECT TRIM("Code") AS "Code", SUBSTR_BEFORE(TRIM("Code") || '@', '@') AS "ParamCode", "Name" AS "CnName", "U_FromFc" AS "FromFc", "U_ToFc" AS "ToFc", "U_Value" AS "Value", CASE WHEN ? BETWEEN IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM("U_FromFc"), ''), '0000-00') AND IFNULL(NULLIF(TRIM("U_ToFc"), ''), '9999-99') THEN 'Y' ELSE '' END AS "InFc" FROM "@MTC_CA_PARAM" ORDER BY 2, 4

paramLocks.sql: SELECT SUBSTR_BEFORE("Code" || '@', '@') AS "ParamCode", COUNT(*) AS "Rows" FROM "MTC_CA_C_PARAM_B1" WHERE "Locked" = 'Y' GROUP BY SUBSTR_BEFORE("Code" || '@', '@')

paramOverview.sql: SELECT D."Category", D."ParamCode", D."CnName", D."DataType", E."Value" AS "EffValue", E."Src", D."Hint", D."SortNo" FROM "MTC_CA_C_PARAM_DEF" D LEFT JOIN (SELECT "ParamCode", "Value", CASE WHEN "Descr" LIKE '%B1 @MTC_CA_%' THEN 'B1' ELSE '种子值' END AS "Src" FROM "MTC_CA_C_PARAM" WHERE ? BETWEEN "FromFc" AND "ToFc" UNION ALL SELECT "Usage", "AcctCode", CASE WHEN "Descr" LIKE '%B1 @MTC_CA_%' THEN 'B1' ELSE '种子值' END FROM "MTC_CA_C_ACCT" WHERE "Usage" IN ('MFG_EXP_PREFIX', 'LAB_EXP') AND ? BETWEEN "FromFc" AND "ToFc") E ON E."ParamCode" = D."ParamCode" UNION ALL SELECT '不在参数表维护', P."ParamCode", P."Descr", P."DataType", P."Value", CASE WHEN P."Descr" LIKE '%B1 @MTC_CA_%' THEN 'B1' ELSE '种子值' END, CASE WHEN P."ParamCode" = 'CLOSE_DIF_POOL' THEN '在费用池上勾“关单差异池”' ELSE '没有登记在参数目录 MTC_CA_C_PARAM_DEF' END, 9999 FROM "MTC_CA_C_PARAM" P WHERE ? BETWEEN P."FromFc" AND P."ToFc" AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "MTC_CA_C_PARAM_DEF" D WHERE D."ParamCode" = P."ParamCode") ORDER BY 8, 2

cfgEffective.sql: SELECT "ParamCode", "Value", CASE WHEN "Descr" LIKE '%B1 @MTC_CA_%' THEN 'B1' ELSE '种子值' END AS "Src", "FromFc", "ToFc", "Descr" FROM "MTC_CA_C_PARAM" WHERE ? BETWEEN "FromFc" AND "ToFc" UNION ALL SELECT "Usage", "AcctCode", CASE WHEN "Descr" LIKE '%B1 @MTC_CA_%' THEN 'B1' ELSE '种子值' END, "FromFc", "ToFc", "Descr" FROM "MTC_CA_C_ACCT" WHERE "Usage" IN ('MFG_EXP_PREFIX', 'LAB_EXP') AND ? BETWEEN "FromFc" AND "ToFc" ORDER BY 3, 1

b1Qcp.sql: SELECT TOP 2001 "DocNum", "LineNo", "ItemCode", "ItemName", "ItmsGrpCod", "Price", CASE WHEN "Canceled" <> 'N' THEN '已取消，不使用' WHEN IFNULL("Price", 0) = 0 THEN '单价为 0，不使用' WHEN "VCnt" = 1 THEN '使用' WHEN "Price" = "VMax" THEN '重复维护，使用这一行（取最大值）' ELSE '重复维护，不使用（取最大值）' END AS "Used", "Note" FROM (SELECT T0."DocNum", T1."LineId" AS "LineNo", T1."U_ItemCode" AS "ItemCode", T1."U_ItemName" AS "ItemName", T1."U_ItmsGrpCod" AS "ItmsGrpCod", T1."U_Price" AS "Price", IFNULL(T0."Canceled", 'N') AS "Canceled", IFNULL(T1."U_LineMemo", T0."U_Memo") AS "Note", SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(T0."Canceled", 'N') = 'N' AND IFNULL(T1."U_Price", 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."U_ItemCode") AS "VCnt", MAX(CASE WHEN IFNULL(T0."Canceled", 'N') = 'N' AND IFNULL(T1."U_Price", 0) <> 0 THEN T1."U_Price" END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."U_ItemCode") AS "VMax" FROM "@MTC_COST_QCPRICE" T0 JOIN "@MTC_COST_QCPRICE1" T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry" WHERE T0."U_FcCode" = ? AND T1."U_ItemCode" IS NOT NULL AND (? = '' OR T1."U_ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%' OR T1."U_ItmsGrpCod" = ?)) X ORDER BY "ItemCode", "DocNum", "LineNo"

b1Time.sql: SELECT TOP 2001 "DocNum", "LineNo", "ItemCode", "ItemName", "Hours", CASE WHEN "Canceled" <> 'N' THEN '已取消，不使用' WHEN "VCnt" > 1 AND "Hours" = "VMax" THEN '重复维护，使用这一行（取最大值）' WHEN "VCnt" > 1 THEN '重复维护，不使用（取最大值）' WHEN IFNULL("Hours", 0) = 0 THEN '工时为 0，分不到费用' ELSE '使用' END AS "Used", "Note" FROM (SELECT T0."DocNum", T1."LineId" AS "LineNo", T1."U_ItemCode" AS "ItemCode", T1."U_ItemName" AS "ItemName", T1."U_Time" AS "Hours", IFNULL(T0."Canceled", 'N') AS "Canceled", T1."U_Memo" AS "Note", SUM(CASE WHEN IFNULL(T0."Canceled", 'N') = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."U_ItemCode") AS "VCnt", MAX(CASE WHEN IFNULL(T0."Canceled", 'N') = 'N' THEN T1."U_Time" END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."U_ItemCode") AS "VMax" FROM "@MTC_COST_TIME" T0 JOIN "@MTC_COST_TIME1" T1 ON T1."DocEntry" = T0."DocEntry" WHERE T0."U_FcCode" = ? AND T1."U_ItemCode" IS NOT NULL AND (? = '' OR T1."U_ItemCode" LIKE ? || '%')) X ORDER BY "ItemCode", "DocNum", "LineNo"

scenOvrSave.sql: CALL "MTC_CA_P_SCEN_OVR_SAVE"(?, CAST(? AS INT), ?, ?, CAST(? AS DECIMAL(19,6)), ?)

codeKind.sql: SELECT 'ITEM' AS "Kind" FROM "OITM" WHERE "ItemCode" = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'BP' FROM "OCRD" WHERE "CardCode" = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'ORDER' FROM "OWOR" WHERE TO_NVARCHAR("DocNum") = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'ORDER' FROM "@MTC_OWOR" WHERE TO_NVARCHAR("DocNum") = ? UNION ALL SELECT 'POOL' FROM "MTC_CA_C_POOL" WHERE "PoolCode" = ?

tb.sql: SELECT A."Cat", A."AcctCode", A."AcctName", CASE WHEN B."Beg" > 0 THEN B."Beg" END AS "BegDr", CASE WHEN B."Beg" < 0 THEN -B."Beg" END AS "BegCr", B."CurDr", B."CurCr", CASE WHEN B."Beg" + B."CurDr" - B."CurCr" > 0 THEN B."Beg" + B."CurDr" - B."CurCr" END AS "EndDr", CASE WHEN B."Beg" + B."CurDr" - B."CurCr" < 0 THEN -(B."Beg" + B."CurDr" - B."CurCr") END AS "EndCr", B."PendDr", B."PendCr", CASE WHEN B."Beg" + B."CurDr" - B."CurCr" + B."PendDr" - B."PendCr" > 0 THEN B."Beg" + B."CurDr" - B."CurCr" + B."PendDr" - B."PendCr" END AS "AllDr", CASE WHEN B."Beg" + B."CurDr" - B."CurCr" + B."PendDr" - B."PendCr" < 0 THEN -(B."Beg" + B."CurDr" - B."CurCr" + B."PendDr" - B."PendCr") END AS "AllCr" FROM "MTC_CA_F_TB_ACCT"(?) A JOIN (SELECT "AcctCode", IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Src" = 'BEG' THEN "Debit" - "Credit" END), 0) AS "Beg", IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Src" = 'GL' THEN "Debit" END), 0) AS "CurDr", IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Src" = 'GL' THEN "Credit" END), 0) AS "CurCr", IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Src" IN ('VCH', 'DRAFT') AND "Dup" = 'N' THEN "Debit" END), 0) AS "PendDr", IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Src" IN ('VCH', 'DRAFT') AND "Dup" = 'N' THEN "Credit" END), 0) AS "PendCr" FROM "MTC_CA_F_TB_LINE"(CAST(? AS BIGINT), '') GROUP BY "AcctCode") B ON B."AcctCode" = A."AcctCode" WHERE B."Beg" <> 0 OR B."CurDr" <> 0 OR B."CurCr" <> 0 OR B."PendDr" <> 0 OR B."PendCr" <> 0 ORDER BY A."AcctCode"

tbAcctSum.sql: SELECT L."Src", L."TransCode", L."RevOf", C."TrnsCodDsc" AS "TransName", COUNT(*) AS "Lines", SUM(L."Debit") AS "Debit", SUM(L."Credit") AS "Credit" FROM "MTC_CA_F_TB_LINE"(CAST(? AS BIGINT), ?) L LEFT JOIN "OTRC" C ON C."TrnsCode" = L."TransCode" WHERE L."Src" <> 'BEG' AND L."Dup" = 'N' GROUP BY L."Src", L."TransCode", L."RevOf", C."TrnsCodDsc" ORDER BY CASE L."Src" WHEN 'GL' THEN 1 WHEN 'VCH' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, L."TransCode", L."RevOf"

tbLedger.sql: WITH L AS (SELECT CASE "Src" WHEN 'BEG' THEN 0 WHEN 'GL' THEN 1 WHEN 'VCH' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS "Kind", T.* FROM "MTC_CA_F_TB_LINE"(CAST(? AS BIGINT), ?) T), W AS (SELECT L.*, SUM(CASE WHEN "Dup" = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE "Debit" - "Credit" END) OVER (ORDER BY "Kind", "RefDate", "TransId", "LineId" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Bal" FROM L), T AS (SELECT 2 AS "Kind", '本期合计 / 期末余额（已过账）' AS "Memo", IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Kind" = 1 THEN "Debit" END), 0) AS "Debit", IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Kind" = 1 THEN "Credit" END), 0) AS "Credit", IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Kind" <= 1 THEN "Debit" - "Credit" END), 0) AS "Bal" FROM L UNION ALL SELECT 5, '未过账合计 / 含未过账期末余额', IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Kind" >= 3 AND "Dup" = 'N' THEN "Debit" END), 0), IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Kind" >= 3 AND "Dup" = 'N' THEN "Credit" END), 0), IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN "Dup" = 'N' THEN "Debit" - "Credit" END), 0) FROM L) SELECT TOP 2001 X."Kind", X."RefDate", X."Src", X."DocNo", X."TransId", X."LineId", X."TransCode", C."TrnsCodDsc" AS "TransName", X."RevOf", X."ObjType", X."BaseRef", X."Memo", X."OcrCode", X."VendorCode", X."Debit", X."Credit", CASE WHEN X."Bal" > 0 THEN '借' WHEN X."Bal" < 0 THEN '贷' ELSE '平' END AS "Dir", ABS(X."Bal") AS "Balance" FROM (SELECT "Kind", "RefDate", "Src", "DocNo", "TransId", "LineId", "TransCode", "ObjType", "BaseRef", "Memo", "OcrCode", "VendorCode", "Debit", "Credit", "Bal", "RevOf" FROM W WHERE "Kind" = 0 OR ? = '' OR "TransCode" = ? UNION ALL SELECT "Kind", NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, "Memo", NULL, NULL, "Debit", "Credit", "Bal", NULL FROM T) X LEFT JOIN "OTRC" C ON C."TrnsCode" = X."TransCode" ORDER BY X."Kind", X."RefDate", X."TransId", X."LineId"

tbVoucher.sql: SELECT J."Line_ID", J."Account" AS "AcctCode", J."Debit", J."Credit", J."ProfitCode" AS "OcrCode", J."Project", J."U_VendorCode" AS "VendorCode", J."LineMemo" AS "Memo" FROM "JDT1" J WHERE J."TransId" = CAST(? AS INTEGER) ORDER BY J."Line_ID"
